wcdhome.description: Base directory for wcd data files (treedata, stack, alias, ban). Overrides HOME.

wcdscan.description: Colon-separated list of directories to scan for the default treedata file. If empty, defaults to $HOME or / root depending on platform.

wcdfilter.description: Colon-separated list of patterns. Only directories matching these patterns are considered matches.

wcdban.description: Colon-separated list of absolute paths to ban (ignore) in search results.

wcexclude.description: Colon-separated list of paths to exclude from scanning entirely.

wcdstackfile.description: Path to the stack file. If empty, uses default $WCDHOME/.stack.wcd or $HOME/.stack.wcd.

wcdlocaledir.description: Path to the locale directory for translations. If empty, uses compile-time default.

lang.description: Primary language/locale for wcd messages and sorting (e.g., en_US.UTF-8, C).

lc_collate.description: Collation locale for sorting matches (e.g., C for byte order, en_US.UTF-8 for dictionary sort).

wcd_stack_size.description: Maximum size of the directory stack (0 to disable stack).
